newsitem.title: SWEDEN: FORECAST-Swedish December c/a surplus 2.1 bln skr.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Swedish December c/a surplus 2.1 bln skr.

text.p: Sweden's December current account surplus is expected at a 2.1 billion crown ($282.2 million), a Reuters poll of 13 analysts showed on Wednesday.
Forecasts ranged from surpluses of 600 million to four billion crowns, and the median is two billion crowns for the December current account figures, due at 1100 GMT on Friday.
December's balance of trade came in at 9.6 billion crowns.
From January to November, the current account surplus rose to 44.5 billion crowns. Including the December surplus, the 1996 figure is expected to be 46.6 billion crowns.
In November, the current account surplus stood at 6.3 billion crowns. December 1995 posted a deficit of 700 million crowns, with the 1995 total coming in at a surplus of 35.4 billion crowns.

Sources participating in this poll were Aragon, Carnegie, Den Danske Bank, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, Hagstromer & Qviberg, Handelsbanken, HSBC Midland, Nomura, Nordbanken, PaineWebber, S-E-Banken, Transferator and Ohmans.
-- Barbara Taltavull, Stockholm newsroom +46-8-700 1019 ($ = 7.441 Swedish Crowns)
